purpose: the parts a Python and Node run needs; fetch one part at a time with scripts/btk.py fetch --lock

node.role: Node runtime for vendor/py_launch.cjs: Node 26 or later, no upper bound
node.bundled_alternative: a Playwright driver may bundle a Node that meets the 26+ floor; the npm node part above is kept so the Node runtime is chosen separately and is not pinned to a Playwright release

python_playwright.role: observe and act; Python runs under py_launch with no Node packages
python_playwright.note: lower bound in pyproject.toml; uv.lock records the resolved release (1.64.1 at the time of this change). Installed with pip or uv; the integrity is not recorded here. Playwright 1.64.1 expects chromium 156 (chromium-1248); the run checked here used chromium 141 linked under the expected path

chromium.role: browser for observe and act in Chromium
chromium.note: the Playwright CDN is not reachable from this environment, so this part cannot be fetched here; chromium 141 was used for the checks run here
